events.speaker: customer
events.text: The refrigerator is in the upstairs kitchen. The fresh-food compartment is warm even though the freezer is still cold, and it is not leaking.

events.speaker: intake_agent
events.text: When would you prefer a technician to visit? We can note a time window, but we cannot promise it until the schedule is checked.

events.speaker: customer
events.text: Friday morning would be best. I should be home then, and someone can let the technician into the house.

events.speaker: intake_agent
events.text: Would you like a quote before repair work starts, and is there a maximum amount you want us to keep in mind?

events.speaker: customer
events.text: Please provide a quote first. My maximum for the repair is six hundred U.S. dollars, including the visit and any parts.

events.speaker: intake_agent
events.text: I have the upstairs kitchen and Friday morning. Let me confirm those details before I send the request to the service team.

events.speaker: customer
events.text: Correction: I had the location wrong. It is in the basement utility room, and Saturday afternoon is better than Friday morning.

events.speaker: intake_agent
events.text: Thanks for correcting that. I will update the location and appointment preference while keeping the quote request and spending maximum.
